title: My daughter has entered the mall world
content: I told my daughter (16) about mall world recently and she was intrigued and wanted to know more. I explained all the different areas I’ve been to and the different people I encountered. It seems like in nearly (not all) every dream, all three of my kids are with me, but varying ages. She reported one morning she had finally gotten there and each morning thereafter for about two weeks. This particular dream, however, I wanted to share with you all and see if you recognize it. She said she went in an elevator (of course it was erratic) and went to the top of the mall where it was like a giant bouncy house, it had slides that went back into the mall to where the elevator that takes you up. She also said it was out of order, but somehow people were still going up there. Anyone else been to the top? I know I’ve seen and been on lots of different slides there and have entered portals, too.
